# Settings reference

Every setting the product knows, from every module's declaration (E6.1). Scopes are where a value may be configured; the value in force at a scope is its own, else the nearest ancestor's, else the default.

| Setting | Kind | Scopes | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `api.cors.allowed_origins` | String | organization |  | Browser origins allowed to call the API, comma-separated; empty for none. |
| `auth.integrity.verify_interval` | Duration | organization | 01:00:00 | How often every signed security row is re-verified. |
| `auth.local.lockout_duration` | Duration | organization | 00:15:00 | How long a locked local account stays locked. |
| `auth.local.lockout_threshold` | Integer | organization | 5 | Failed sign-ins before a local account is locked. |
| `auth.oidc.authority` | String | organization |  | The OpenID Connect issuer (authority) URL; discovery is read from it. |
| `auth.oidc.client_id` | String | organization |  | The client id registered at the provider. |
| `auth.oidc.client_secret` | Secret | organization |  | The client secret (stored encrypted); empty for a public client with PKCE only. |
| `auth.oidc.display_name` | String | organization | Single sign-on | The label of the OIDC sign-in option on the login page. |
| `auth.oidc.display_name_claim` | String | organization | name | The claim type used as the display name. |
| `auth.oidc.group_claim` | String | organization | groups | The claim type carrying the directory groups used for role mapping. |
| `auth.oidc.name_claim` | String | organization | preferred_username | The claim type used as the console sign-in name. |
| `auth.oidc.require_https` | Boolean | organization | true | Refuse a provider whose discovery document is not served over HTTPS; switch off only in a lab. |
| `auth.oidc.scopes` | String | organization | openid profile email | The scopes requested, space-separated; openid is always included. |
| `auth.providers.enabled` | String | organization | local | Identity providers the console offers, comma-separated, in login-page order (local, oidc). |
| `auth.session.idle_timeout` | Duration | organization | 00:30:00 | How long a console session may sit idle before it ends. |
| `auth.session.lifetime` | Duration | organization | 08:00:00 | How long a console session may last in total. |
| `license.keys` | Secret | organization |  | The installed license keys, one signed document per line (stored encrypted). Managed through the license page; the compiled-in free tier needs none. |
| `license.overage_since.devices` | Timestamp | organization | 1970-01-01T00:00:00.0000000+00:00 | When the connected devices (active in the last 30 days) count first exceeded the licensed value (UTC); the grace period counts from here. In the past when the count is within the limit. |
| `license.overage_since.max_totes_per_picker` | Timestamp | organization | 1970-01-01T00:00:00.0000000+00:00 | When the totes per picker count first exceeded the licensed value (UTC); the grace period counts from here. In the past when the count is within the limit. |
| `license.overage_since.sites` | Timestamp | organization | 1970-01-01T00:00:00.0000000+00:00 | When the sites count first exceeded the licensed value (UTC); the grace period counts from here. In the past when the count is within the limit. |
| `license.overage_since.users` | Timestamp | organization | 1970-01-01T00:00:00.0000000+00:00 | When the users and pickers count first exceeded the licensed value (UTC); the grace period counts from here. In the past when the count is within the limit. |
| `license.usage_warning_percent` | Integer | organization | 80 | The percentage of a limit at which the console warns and an issue is raised. |
| `logging.elevated_level` | Enum | organization | Information | The minimum level while the timed elevation runs (Trace, Debug or Information). One of: `Trace`, `Debug`, `Information`, `Warning`, `Error`, `Critical`, `None`. |
| `logging.elevated_until` | Timestamp | organization | 1970-01-01T00:00:00.0000000+00:00 | When the timed elevation ends (UTC); in the past when there is none. |
| `logging.elevation_max_minutes` | Integer | organization | 120 | The longest timed elevation, in minutes. |
| `logging.level` | Enum | organization | Information | The server's minimum log level. One of: `Trace`, `Debug`, `Information`, `Warning`, `Error`, `Critical`, `None`. |
| `picking.max_totes_per_picker` | Integer | organization, site, zone | 1 | Totes a picker may carry at once. The effective value is the lower of this setting and the license's max_totes_per_picker. |
